proposed_rules.trigger: A full-bleed sibling node with no text and no [bg:*] tag, immediately followed/overlapped by a narrower centered heading+paragraph node — same visual pattern as a background-image hero but implemented as an /
proposed_rules.decision: Treat identically to full-width-image-behind-text-is-section-bg: the media becomes the section background/visual, the overlaid heading+paragraph becomes default-content. Do not emit a separate image block.
proposed_rules.rationale: The extraction tool only tags CSS background zones with [bg:*]; a full-bleed /

proposed_rules.trigger: A stack of single-column [2x1] zones each with an H2/paragraph, heights varying, alternating down the page.
proposed_rules.decision: Map each row as its own section with default-content (H2+paragraph). Do not group rows into one repeating block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternative: repeating-cards-are-one-block — rejected because the three rows differ in height (514,494,348px) and content shape, indicating distinct authored sections rather than a uniform card grid.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [bg:gradient] or [bg:color] zone of substantial height (~500px) positioned immediately before the footer, with no captured text.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction — this is very likely a CTA banner (heading + button) whose text failed to render/capture, not decorative-only background.
proposed_rules.rationale: The same empty gradient band recurs at the same position (just above footer) across multiple pages; treating it as decoration-only risks dropping a real CTA.

notes: Tour/database feature page: hero uses an untagged full-bleed media element rather than a [bg:*]-tagged background; the page ends with an empty gradient band that likely hides an uncaptured CTA banner before the footer.
